decisions.title: Market-Data Provider Selection

options.option_a: Tiingo Power ($30/mo): Recommended for daily EOD bar research, point-in-time corporate actions, REST simplicity, zero daemon overhead.
options.option_b: Alpaca Algo Trader Plus ($9/mo): Recommended if full-stack simulated paper order placement and fill mocking are required.

blockers: Owner has not selected provider or funded account.

decisions.title: Data Licensing & Privacy Compliance
prerequisites: Owner must verify their personal non-professional subscriber status with chosen vendor.
Owner must acknowledge that standard subscriptions do NOT authorize bulk database redistribution.
Owner must formally acknowledge and accept vendor post-termination data purge mandates.
blockers: Lack of signed owner declaration and subscription contract verification.

decisions.title: Primary Statistical Endpoint & Non-Inferiority Budget

specifications.primary_hurdle: Reject H02: E[d_t | I_{def,t}=1] <= 10 bps using Newey-West HAC (q = floor(4*(N_def/100)^(2/9))) and Stationary Block Bootstrap.
specifications.secondary_constraint: Delta CAGR >= -200 bps (Operational risk-budget heuristic; not a formal statistical non-inferiority proof).

blockers: Owner has not formally signed off on the 10-bps hurdle or secondary risk budget.

decisions.title: Evaluation Horizon & Power Protocol

specifications.horizon: 252 trading sessions with mandatory N_def >= 30 defensive sessions floor.
specifications.extension: Contingent extension up to 504 sessions if N_def < 30 at session 252 (market-dependent, outcome-independent).
specifications.stopping_rules: Strict prohibition on optional stopping. Catastrophic circuit breaker at D2 drawdown > E0 drawdown + 300 bps.

blockers: Owner has not ratified the 252/504-session protocol.

decisions.title: Fail-Closed Monitoring & Incident SRE Architecture

specifications.recovery_model: Fail-closed persistent INCIDENT_LOCK requiring human cryptographic reset.
specifications.restart_policy: No automated blind restart loops; external watchdog operates strictly out-of-band without trading keys.
specifications.accounting: Double-entry replay through DecimalAccountingOracle required before any signal processing.

blockers: OS-level daemon supervisor unconfigured; owner must assume custody of reset keys.

decisions.title: Prospective Evaluation Activation Authority
decisions.prerequisites: Requires unanimous completion and owner ratification of DEC-01 through DEC-05, followed by manual owner execution of cryptographic activation script.
